market_view: Calm but firming risk regime: VIX 16.0 (+7.5% on the day, 48% below its 1-year high), 10-year yield 4.70% near its 1-year high and rising, dollar soft (-1.1% in 5 days). Crude jumped 8% in 5 days on Iran sanctions threats; gold keeps rising despite yields.

oil_gas.reasoning: The Iran escalation already repriced crude and XOM sits near its high. No new Hormuz closure or supply loss that crude has not moved on. Windfall-tax risk remains two-sided. Stay flat.

gold_miners.catalyst: Continuing hold from 2026-08-10: Barrick-Newmont Nevada $1.95B settlement cleared uncertainty; gold 4571 (+3.4% in 5 days) keeps rising with a softer dollar; 'Why Is Newmont Stock Surging Friday?' (Yahoo Finance)
gold_miners.reasoning: No exit trigger: gold is rising, not falling, while the 10-year edges up; no negative settlement details. Hold to the planned exit around 2026-08-24, then go flat. Big 20-day run (+35%) raises reversal risk, so confidence stays modest.

chips.reasoning: SOX -4.5% in 5 days, AVGO -12.9%; NVDA -3.75%. Earnings in the window add variance, not direction; AI-bond and valuation worries cut the other way. No export-rule change or guidance news. Flat.

pharma.catalyst: none: no LLY-specific headline in the record
pharma.reasoning: LLY was exited on 2026-08-18; it fell 2.8% yesterday with the whole sector (XLV -1.9%). No trial, approval or pricing news to re-enter. Flat.

copper_uranium.catalyst: Continuing hold from 2026-07-31: Congo copper concentrate export ban keeps supply tight; no reversal or exemption in the record
copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX +3.1% yesterday, 0.7% off its 1-year high; copper eased 2% in 5 days but is only 3.6% off its high, not a reversal. Hold to the planned exit around 2026-08-28; exit early on ban reversal or a sharper copper drop.

would_change_my_mind: A sharp 10-year yield jump with gold falling (exit NEM), Congo lifting or exempting the export ban or copper breaking down (exit FCX), or a new unpriced Hormuz supply loss (consider XOM).
